source.title: Ashenvale Mission IX: Recover Dream-Touched Dragonegg
source.description: While these demons distract us here, the Emerald Dream is being corrupted into nightmare. Quick, travel through the Emerald Dream Portal in Bough Shadow, and journey to the Nightmare Incursion in Forest Song. Retrieve a Dream-Touched Dragonegg and deliver it to me.
source.objective: Recover a Dream-Touched Dragonegg in the Ashenvale Nightmare Incursion from the central ruin in Forest Song and return to Field Captain Hannalah.
source.completion: Well done! Your services shall be well rewarded. Perhaps another mission?
